full_judgment:
Nazmun Ara Sultana, J: This civil appeal by leave, at the instance of the plaintiff directed against the judgment and order dated 24-3-2004 passed by a single Bench of the 1-ligh Court Division in Civil Revision No.1515 of 1997 making the Rule absolute and thereby setting aside the judgment and decree dated 25-2-1997 passed by the Additional District Judge, 2nd Court, Narayanganj in Title Appeal No. 60 of 1996 dismissing the appeal affirming the judgment and decree dated 22-6-1996 passed by the Additional Subordinate Judge, Narayanganj in Title Suit No.437 of 1992 decreeing the suit. 

 4. The trial Court, on consideration of evidence adduced by both the parties and facts circumstances decreed the suit. The appellate Court below affirmed this judgment and decree of the trial Court. 

 18. However, on examination of the impugned judgment of the High Court Division, those of the Courts below and the evidence and other materials on record, we find that both the Courts of fact, on meticulous examination of the evidence and all other facts, rightly found the alleged bainapatra, the Exhibit 1 genuine and therefore rightly decreed the suit for specific performance of contract. The High Court Division, on making some erroneous observations and findings, set-aside the concurrent findings and decisions of the Courts of fact most unjustly and illegally. The observations and findings of the High Court Division, the revisional Court, for dismissing the suit for specific performance of contract setting aside the concurrent findings and decisions of the Courts of facts are all erroneous and unacceptable and hence the impugned judgment of the High Court Division cannot be sustained.
